answer: In this PoA design, identity verification is bound to a Wesolowski VDF: each candidate must complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings before its proof can be checked. Cloning identities multiplies these time-locks, but GPUs cannot shorten an individual chain through parallel execution, imposing a physical latency floor. Thus sybil expansion becomes costly and time-limited, not a fable, while each valid signal is anchored to a computed result at the wharf.
